verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a hosted product-catalog API, and a buyer could fairly ask whether such a service offers a self-hostable deployment, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows the hosted production API (api.trychannel3.com), SDK, CLI, MCP and pay-per-credit access. Nothing documents a self-hosted, on-prem or open-source deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
